gaps.sentence: They had no ___ but to call the police.
He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
The report needs ___ before Friday, doesn't it?
The meeting was put ___ until Thursday.
She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.
'Would you like…?' is the polite offer; 'Do you like' asks about a general preference.

gaps.sentence: We should make the ___ of the good weather.
gaps.explanation: 'make the most of' = get the maximum benefit from.
